## Key Insights

1. Summer Sowing Status: Summer sowing data collection has been started from 7th February, 2025 and the sowing is in preliminary stage. As on February 21, 2025, the area sown under summer crops is 22.317 lakh ha as compared to 21.845 lakh ha during the corresponding period of  last  year.  Of  this,  area  of  19.492  lakh  ha  has  been  sown  under  rice  this  year  against  the previous year area of 18.197 lakh ha (increase of 1.295 lakh ha).
2. Rabi Season Area Coverage : For Rabi horticulture crops ,  major producing states report the following sowing areas: Onion - 10.29 lakh ha (8.63 lakh ha last year), Potato - 19.82 lakh ha (19.51 lakh ha last year), Tomato - 2.41 lakh ha (2.42 lakh ha last year).
3. Weather Update :
- a) Temperature: Minimum temperatures are likely to fall 2-4°C over Northwest India during next 4 days No significant change in minimum temperatures is expected over Central India during  next  3  days,  with  a  rise  of  2-4°C  thereafter.  No  significant  change  in  minimum temperatures over rest parts of  India  during  next  4-5 days.  A  gradual  rise  in  maximum temperatures by 2-4°C is likely over Northwest India during the next 4 days. No significant change in maximum temperatures is expected over Central India during next 3 days, with a rise of 2-4°C thereafter. No significant change in maximum temperatures over rest parts of India during next 4-5 days.
- b) Rainfall Distribution: From January 01- February 23, 2025, the All-India cumulative rainfall is 64% below its Long Period Average (LPA), with regional variations: (i) East & Northeast India: -25%; (ii) Northwest India: -72%; (iii) Central India: -89%; and South Peninsula: -48%
6.  A  fresh  Western  Disturbance  is  seen  as  a  cyclonic  circulation  over  north  Iran  & neighborhood from lower to upper tropospheric levels. Higher moisture feeding is also  likely  over  Western  Himalayan  Region  in  lower  tropospheric  levels  from Arabian Sea mainly during 25th -28th February, 2025.
7.  Isolated  to  scattered  light  to  moderate  rainfall  likely  over  Punjab,  Haryana,  and Chandigarh during 26th February-01st March; over West Uttar Pradesh & Rajasthan during 27th February-01st March; over West Rajasthan on 27th & 28th February and East Uttar Pradesh, East Rajasthan on 28th February & 01st February.

## 4. Inputs Situation

- a) Water Reservoir Status : As of February 20, 2025, the live storage in 155 major reservoirs is 98.974 BCM (55% of total capacity). Storage is at 120% of last year's level and 116% of the 10-year average. The overall storage position is better than the corresponding period of last year  in  the  country  as  a  whole  and  is  also  better  than  the  Normal  storage  during  the corresponding period.

- c) Seeds  and  Fertilizers :  For  Rabi  2024-25,  certified  seed  availability  is  337.98  lakh  quintals against a requirement of 307.07 lakh quintals, ensuring a surplus of 30.90 lakh quintals. The fertilizer supply remains stable across all products.

## Rainfall Forecast:

## 20 th  Feb - 26 th  Feb 2025

- a) A  fresh  Western  Disturbance  is  seen  as  a  cyclonic  circulation  over  north  Pakistan  & neighborhood    in  lower  tropospheric  levels  with  a  trough  aloft  in  middle  &  upper tropospheric level with its axis at 5.8 km above mean sea level roughly along Long. 70 ○ E to  the  north  of  Lat.  30 ○ N.  The  induced  cyclonic  circulation  lies  over  West  Rajasthan &neighborhood in lower tropospheric levels.
- b) Isolated  to  scattered  light  to  moderate  rainfall  likely  over  Punjab,  Haryana,  and Chandigarh west Uttar Pradesh on 20th February ; with thunderstorm & lightning likely over East Uttar Pradesh, nort chhattisgarh on 20th February.

## Details of each Segment

- c) A  cyclonic  circulation  lies  over  central  Assam  in  lower  tropospheric  levels.  under  its influence, Isolated to scattered light rainfall activity likely over Northeast India and SubHimalayan West Bengal & Sikkim during next 7 days. and Heavy rainfall at isolated places likely over Arunachal Pradesh on 21st Feb.

## 27 th  Feb - 05 th  Mar, 2025

- d) Under the influence of an active western disturbance, fairly widespread to widespread rainfall/snowfall is likely over Western Himalayan Region during 1st half of the week. Isolated  heavy  rainfall/snowfall  also  likely  on  27th  &  28th  February  over  the  region. Isolated  to  scattered  light/moderate  rainfall  likely  over  adjoining  plains  of  northwest India during the same period.
- e) Light/moderate  isolated  to  scattered  rainfall  is  also  likely  over  northeast  India  and extreme south Peninsular India during some days of the week.
- f) Overall,  rainfall  is  likely  to  be  below  normal  over  all  the  homogeneous  regions  of  the country during the week except northwest India & extreme south Peninsular India, where above normal rainfall activity is likely.

## Temperature Forecast

## 20 th  Feb - 26 th  Feb 2025

- a) A gradual decrease in minimum temperatures by 2-3°C is likely over Central India during the first half of the week, and no significant changes thereafter. In East India , a sharper drop of 3-5°C is likely over the next two days, followed by stable temperatures for the rest of the week.
- b) No significant changes in minimum temperature in Maharashtra for the next 24 hours, and gradual increase of 2-3°C is expected for the following days.
- c) Maximum temperatures are likely to be above normal by 3-5°C over north Peninsular & East India during most days of the week.

## 27 th  Feb - 05 th  Mar, 2025

- d) Minimum temperatures are likely to be below normal by 1-2°C to near normal over most parts of country except Western Himalayan Region, Uttar Pradesh, Bihar and northeast India, Where it is likely to be above normal by 1-2°C during the week.
- e) There is no probability of cold wave conditions over any part of the country.
- f) Maximum temperatures are likely to be above normal by 2-4°C over east & adjoining central India and many parts of Western Himalayan Region and northeast India. It is likely to be below normal 1-2°C to near normal over rest parts of the country .
